title: JailBound: Jailbreaking Internal Safety Boundaries of Vision-Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical adversarial attack (jailbreaking) for Vision-Language Models. While it uses safety datasets that include categories like 'Hate Speech' and identifies rejection templates related to 'Moral or Social Judgment', its core research objective is the security mechanism of crossing latent boundaries, not the evaluation or benchmarking of religious, moral, or ethical reasoning frameworks.
